Heart of Missoula.name: Heart of Missoula
Heart of Missoula.description: Central downtown core with Higgins Avenue retail, the Wilma, and the Missoula Farmers Market adjacency.

Riverfront.name: Riverfront
Riverfront.description: Clark Fork riverfront corridor with Caras Park, the Brennan's Wave surf amenity, and mixed-use redevelopment.

University District.name: University District
University District.description: University of Montana campus-adjacent historic district with student housing turnover and academic-adjacent licensing.

Franklin to the Fort.name: Franklin to the Fort
Franklin to the Fort.description: Transitional corridor between UM and the South Hills with single-family infill and small-scale commercial.

Lewis & Clark.name: Lewis & Clark
Lewis & Clark.description: Southwest residential neighborhood of mid-century ranch homes with steady renovation permitting.

Southgate Triangle.name: Southgate Triangle
Southgate Triangle.description: Southgate Mall retail node and surrounding garden-apartment stock with commercial renovation and tenant-improvement permits.

South 39th Street.name: South 39th Street
South 39th Street.description: South-central residential corridor of post-war single-family homes with modest renovation cyclics.

Two Rivers.name: Two Rivers
Two Rivers.description: Clark Fork / Bitterroot confluence neighborhood with large-lot single-family and rural-urban fringe permitting.

Westside.name: Westside
Westside.description: West Missoula corridor with Reserve Street commercial spine and working-class single-family stock.

Rose Park.name: Rose Park
Rose Park.description: Rose Park neighborhood with early-20th-century bungalows, mature tree canopy, and steady kitchen/bathroom renovation permits.

River Road.name: River Road
River Road.description: West-side river corridor of newer subdivisions and large-lot residential with new-build permitting volume.

Moose Can Gully.name: Moose Can Gully
Moose Can Gully.description: Southwest gully neighborhood of exurban subdivisions with well-septic permitting and rural character.

Northside.name: Northside
Northside.description: North Missoula industrial-residential mix with the rail yard, Northside neighborhood, and warehouse-to-residential conversions.

Grant Creek.name: Grant Creek
Grant Creek.description: Northern valley corridor with master-planned subdivisions, golf course adjacency, and hotel/commercial development.

Marshall Canyon.name: Marshall Canyon
Marshall Canyon.description: Marshall Mountain foothills neighborhood with newer single-family construction and wildland-urban interface permitting.

Lower Rattlesnake.name: Lower Rattlesnake
Lower Rattlesnake.description: Established Rattlesnake Valley floor neighborhood with leafy streets, mid-century homes, and steady renovation permits.

Upper Rattlesnake.name: Upper Rattlesnake
Upper Rattlesnake.description: Upper Rattlesnake Creek corridor with large estate lots, high-value remodels, and hillside building permits.

Captain John Mullan.name: Captain John Mullan
Captain John Mullan.description: East Mullan Road corridor with big-box retail, office parks, and the metro's largest commercial permit pipeline.

Miller Creek.name: Miller Creek
Miller Creek.description: Southern exurban corridor along Miller Creek Road with new subdivisions, well/septic permits, and rural-residential growth.

Farviews / Pattee Canyon.name: Farviews / Pattee Canyon
Farviews / Pattee Canyon.description: Southeast hillside neighborhood with Pattee Canyon recreation access, custom home construction, and forest-interface permits.
